summary: Magic Empire Global Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of CFO Yau Ting Tai effective June 15, 2026, for personal reasons with no disagreement, and the appointment of Mei Wang as CFO effective June 17, 2026. Wang brings 33 years of banking experience from Agricultural Bank of China, including as President of Jinan Free Trade Zone Sub-branch. No deal terms, advisors, or premium are applicable. The change is immediate with no structural mechanics. What to watch is whether the new CFO signals any strategic shift.
